title: A Clean Sweep
overview: Amateur baseball players go up against legendary pros in a championship to determine the ultimate winning team.

title: Animals on the Loose: A You vs. Wild Movie
overview: When there’s a power outage at a safari reserve, Bear Grylls is called and he needs your help. The situation is dire: an escaped lion is headed for a nearby village; a baboon has broken free and is going towards the sea cliffs, and the power must be restored before more animals escape.

title: Blown Away: Christmas
overview: 'Tis the season for five returning artists to fill the hot shop with festive designs. One will win cash for the stocking — a merry Christmas indeed!

title: Dance 100
overview: To win $100,000, eight choreographers must create increasingly complex routines for an ever-growing number of elite dancers — who are also the judges.

title: Death by Magic
overview: Magician Drummond Money-Coutts travels the globe, sharing his infectious love of his craft and attempting feats that proved fatal to other magicians.

title: Dhee Double Impact
overview: Jani Master returns for an electrifying Grand Launch, as the Star Masters and a new wave of talent set the stage for a season demanding double the skill.

title: Drive Hard: The Maloof Way
overview: The Maloofs, a lovable family of gearheads and stunt drivers, use their passion and skill to build car engines and perform wild feats behind the wheel.

title: Fastest Car
overview: The drivers of exotic supercars put their street cred on the line against deceptively fast sleeper cars built and modified by true gearheads.

title: Hyperdrive
overview: Elite street racers from around the world test their limits in supercharged custom cars on the biggest, baddest automotive obstacle course ever built.

title: Iron Chef Brazil
overview: Rising culinary talents battle Brazil’s best chefs to be named Iron Legend in this exhilarating competition hosted by Fernanda Souza and Andressa Cabral.

title: Lava Ka Dhaava
overview: Actor Jaaved Jaafferi brings his signature humor to this Hindi dubbing of the show where teams creatively navigate rooms flooded with make-believe lava.

title: New World
overview: In this reality show, six celebs strategize and sabotage to earn virtual currency they can cash in on the final day of their stay on a utopian island.

title: Piñata Masters!
overview: Which of the seven participating teams will be the Piñata Heroes? Their piñatas have to be colorful, creative and impress the picky jury: a group of kids!

title: Restaurant War Street King Thailand
overview: Thailand's best street food chefs face off against one another. With a life-changing cash prize and the chance of a professional career at stake, who will emerge as the ultimate winner under the guidance of experienced chefs?

title: Rhythm + Flow: Poland
overview: Aspiring Polish rappers drop bars, battle, and craft tracks to impress judges Bedoes 2115, DZIARMA, and Sokół — vying for fame and a 500,000 złoty prize.

title: Rugged Rugby: Conquer or Die
overview: In the shadows of Korea's rugby world, seven teams engage in a fierce battle of strength, strategy, and teamwork — all vying to be crowned champion.

title: Run for the Money
overview: In a race with time, celebrity contestants desperately try to outmaneuver black-clad Hunters in pursuit, for a chance to win a growing cash prize.

title: Siren: Survive the Island
overview: 24 female police officers, firefighters, bodyguards, soldiers, athletes and stuntwomen team up by profession to compete for survival on a remote island.

title: Southern Survival
overview: The BattlBox crew tests out products designed to help people survive dangerous situations, including explosions, natural disasters and intruders.

title: Star Search
overview: Bigger talent. Higher stakes. Your vote. Anthony Anderson hosts the iconic competition show for a new generation – live. The search is on.

title: Sugar Rush Christmas
overview: It's everything you love about "Sugar Rush" -- with a holly jolly holiday twist -- in this Christmas-themed spin on competitive baking.

title: Surviving Paradise
overview: In this reality competition, players must form alliances and fight to move from the wilderness into a luxurious villa for a shot at a huge cash prize.

title: The Circle Brazil
overview: In this fun reality competition, online players try their best to flirt, bond and catfish their way to a R$300,000 prize.

title: The Fastest
overview: In this unpredictable and thrilling racing competition, drivers from the Middle East with something to prove battle on the track for a cash prize.

title: The Law of the Jungle
overview: Twelve people abandoned in the jungle must work as a team, or sabotage each other for a cut of a jackpot. Every player has their price — what's yours?

title: Toughest Forces on Earth
overview: Three adventurous veterans train alongside some of the world's most elite military units, getting an inside look at their tactics and weaponry.

title: Ultimate Beastmaster
overview: In this intense obstacle course series, elite athletes from the U.S. and other countries compete for cash prizes, individual glory and national pride.

title: We Are the Champions
overview: Explore the quirkiest, most charming, and oddly inspirational competitions you never knew existed, and the determined, passionate, and incredibly skilled competitors who put it all on the line to become heroes in their own extraordinary worlds.

title: White Rabbit Project
overview: Kari Byron, Tory Belleci and Grant Imahara rank history's greatest inventions, heists and more.

title: You vs. Wild: Out Cold
overview: After a plane crash leaves Bear with amnesia, he must make choices to save the missing pilot and survive in this high-stakes interactive adventure.
